description: VTB validation set: 12 Toolathlon Gym tasks ordered by SFT-gain signal. Nine tasks were solved by at least one of three SFT baselines and neither base-model run; three additional tasks cover arxiv-latex, canvas, and youtube-transcript. All 21 non-infrastructure MCP servers are covered. Inferred subset scores are base 0/12 and SFT 5/12 per model. Selection details are in benchmarks/eigent-ai__toolathlon_gym/manifest.json. Grading reads the same ordered list through split.json; changing it requires a new grading state and service restart. Order determines --limit prefixes.
